doc_drift_observations_not_blocking: Runbook A3 names Pro tables 'listora_credit_log' and 'listora_saved_searches'; the live schema has 'listora_credit_ledger' + 'listora_credit_gateway_log' + 'listora_credit_processed_events' and no 'saved_searches' table at all -- table names drifted from the runbook, not a plugin defect.

Runbook C.cron table lists 6 hooks; the live install runs 7 (adds wb_listora_review_reminder_cron) and names two differently (wb_listora_check_expirations / wb_listora_draft_reminder_cron both present, correctly on Action Scheduler not WP-Cron) -- doc undercounts, behavior is correct.

Runbook C.rest.app-config lists enable_guest_submission as a required key; it is deliberately absent from the live response with an explanatory code comment (includes/rest/class-settings-controller.php:520-524) -- guest submission no longer exists as a feature (anonymous POST /submit correctly returns 401), so the key was intentionally dropped to stop native apps rendering a guest path that always fails. Not a bug; runbook is stale on this point.
